title: Scotch Dinner at The Garrison
seo_title: Scotch Dinner at The Garrison – Dec 1, 2026
description: This is a curated Scotch dinner at The Garrison featuring four pours and a specialty cocktail, led by a mixologist who guides a tasting tour of the Highlands, Lowlands, Islay, and Speyside. The pours are paired with a seven-course dinner inspired by traditional Scottish fare with a Garrison/Ozarks twist. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:00 PM at The Garrison.
